desc: 露营登山净水八镜漏斗：白底主图、利益、痛点、场景、对比、微距、规格、信任收口
name: 户外露营随身净水泡腾片款

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一镜：白底摆拍抢点击，瓶身与散落片剂一眼交代产品形态。
一秒法则交代核心利益：片剂入水即处理大容量储水，数值只留空位。
shots.textZone: 顶部三分之一横幅留白，仅放置 「{callout_1}」 占位

shots.intent: 放大野外与应急场景的断水焦虑，把产品放进解决发生的那一刻。
让买家自我代入：露营、徒步、舟钓、荒漠各场景共用一件随身产品。
shots.textZone: 四格各一处短语标签位，仅容纳 「{callout_1}」 至 「{callout_4}」 占位

shots.intent: 用双栏对照结构承接理性决策，主张格全部留空由真实资料回填。
shots.textZone: 顶部两枚标题块与六行主张格全部留空，仅预留 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 空位

shots.intent: 微距证明做工与形态：平整片剂表面、螺纹防盗盖与压边封口细节。
一次交代可选规格与件数，平铺排列消除选择疑虑。
shots.textZone: 底部一条空白规格参数行与三枚空白标签块，不填任何字符

shots.intent: 收口降风险：同行者背影与空白资质留证位承接下单决策。
shots.textZone: 顶部开放天空带一条收口语位 「{selling_point_1}」，右下角三枚空印章框无字符

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio field #FFFFFF for packshots and macro, ice-blue infographic panel #DCE7F2 for data screens, deep lake-blue #2F5D8C for benefit and close panels; one panel per shot, no gradient murals
style.direction: clean outdoor water-treatment commerce with cool infographic panels
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in a center rail, accent #3FA0DC, flat style, no 3D and no shading
style.lightingSystem: cool key light from the upper left around 6500K, soft wrap fill, soft contact shadows grounding every object, controlled highlight on glossy surfaces, no harsh specular blowout
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool outdoor water-treatment commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio field #FFFFFF, ice-blue infographic panel #DCE7F2, deep lake-blue #2F5D8C and one bright water accent #3FA0DC; cool key light from the upper left around 6500K with soft wrap fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline and short label rows only; thin single-weight line icons in a center rail; matte stone, pale sand and seamless studio surfaces; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the upright container with pieces fanned at its base; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the upright container, container always grounded by a contact shadow, single piece units fanned at the base, product never occluded by props or hands
style.surfaceSystem: glossy seamless studio field #FFFFFF, fine pale sand field #E3D9C6, matte rock ledge #B8BFC6, matte board panel #DCE7F2
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline plus short label rows, all rendered copy limited to placeholder slots
